description: Relative path of the kept copy of an externally changed file: `<stem>.conflict-<STAMP>.<ext>` where STAMP is UTC YYYYMMDD-HHMM (tests replace the live stamp with the literal STAMP). Only the file name is split at its last dot. When the copy already exists, both implementations add -2, -3 (see collisions).

collisions.description: With N copies already present the next free name gets -2, -3, ... before the extension.
